changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: EXCHANGE is the listing/clearing venue and belongs to equities only, so decision #21 requires it NULL on .crypto spot — the venue is carried by INST.PRODUCT_XREF instead. Also sets CCY to the pair's quote leg, which LiveApplyOrchestrator stamps onto TRADE.TRANSACTION.TRANS_CCY_CD, and rewrites the stale "BTC-USD" description left by the rename to btcusdt.crypto. Soft-versioned via SP_INS_PRODUCT; idempotent.
